title: Right click
drDigitalIntro:
A right click opens a hidden menu of extra options.
• On a trackpad: tap with two fingers at the same time.
• On a mouse: press the right mouse button (the right side of the mouse).
• A small pop-up menu will appear with extra choices.
• Try it below: right-click the link to open it in a new tab.

playgroundTask.instructions: Right-click the link below, then choose "Open link in new tab".

drDigitalSuccess: Right-clicking opened a menu of things you can do with whatever you clicked on. It works on almost everything.
drDigitalHint: Two fingers at once on the trackpad — or press the right side of your mouse. A menu should pop up. Then choose Open in new tab.
